title: Senior Tax Analyst - Sales and Use Tax Compliance and Reporting
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day. Key Responsibilities Review monthly state sales and use tax returns, tax payments, and other tax filings. Gather, analyze, and validate sales and use tax data to support compliance and reporting requirements. Prepare tax accounting entries related to sales and use tax activities. Research, analyze, interpret, and apply sales and use tax laws to support tax filing positions. Manage sales and use tax registrations, renewals, and account closures. Monitor sales and use tax accounts to ensure ongoing compliance with applicable regulations. Assist in the management of state sales and use tax audits, including gathering supporting documentation, responding to information requests, and performing related research and analysis. Respond to sales and use tax notices and communicate with state and local taxing authorities as needed. Maintain the tax notice log and participate in regular reviews with tax team members to ensure timely resolution of notices and minimize assessments. Respond to sales and use tax inquiries and support internal business groups with tax-related requests and documentation. Prepare and maintain resale and exemption certificates and ensure records are accurately stored and maintained within Vertex Series O. Support the state income tax team with the review of current and amended state income tax returns. Qualifications Education Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Fice, Commerce, or an equivalent educational background. Experience Minimum of 4 years of experience in indirect tax, sales and use tax compliance, tax accounting, public accounting. Experience supporting multi-state sales and use tax filings, tax audits, and tax reporting activities preferred. Experience working in a multinational or shared services environment preferred. Technical Skills Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications. Experience working with ERP and ficial systems such as Oracle, SAP, Workday, or similar platforms. Experience with indirect tax compliance and reporting systems such as Vertex, OneSource, Avalara, or similar tax applications preferred. Ability to analyze large data sets, prepare reconciliations, and maintain accurate tax records. Key Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and global teams. title: Executive - Group Statutory Compliance
description:
About us Prima Group is a Kochi-based agro-industrial group established in 1965. Our businesses include cattle feed manufacturing, edible oil solvent extraction and refining, and packaged drinking water, operating through multiple manufacturing units across Kerala. 
 Role Summary We are looking for an organised, dependable compliance professional to own statutory compliance across all group units. Filings and licence applications are handled by our professional consultants. Your job is to make sure nothing is missed: track every licence and filing, coordinate with consultants and plant teams, check their work, and keep management informed. 
 Key Responsibilities Compliance tracking Build and maintain a single group-wide register of all licences, consents, permits and statutory filings, with expiry and due dates. Initiate renewals 60-90 days before expiry and follow through until the renewed document is received. Consultant coordination Act as the single point of contact between the group's compliance consultants and each unit. Collect documents, data, fees and signatures from units and deliver them to consultants on time. Review consultants' filings and submissions for accuracy; flag errors, delays or unusual charges. Labour compliance Ensure timely PF, ESI, Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund payments and returns for all units. Verify contractor compliance, including PF/ESI coverage of contract workers and contract labour licences. Licensing and inspections Keep licence copies, statutory registers and returns organised and inspection-ready at every unit. Coordinate visits and inspections by labour, factory, boiler, environmental, food safety and local authorities, and track closure of any observations. Reporting Submit a monthly compliance status report to management covering upcoming due dates, pending items and risks. Escalate any lapse or risk of lapse immediately. 
 Preferred candidate profile Essential Graduate; MSW, MBA (HR) or equivalent preferred. 4-7 years of experience handling statutory or HR compliance at a manufacturing company. Hands-on working knowledge of PF and ESI portals, returns and processes. Experience coordinating with licensing or compliance consultants. Fluency in Malayalam and English, spoken and written. Willingness to travel regularly to units across Kerala; two-wheeler or four-wheeler licence. Preferred Exposure to factory, boiler, KSPCB, FSSAI or BIS licensing. Experience in food, feed, edible oil, beverage or chemical manufacturing. Experience managing compliance across more than one unit or location.

Key Skills: Excel,HR Compliance,Compliance Management,Legal Compliance,Statutory Compliance,Regulatory Compliance,Hrsd,Compliance
